title: Voice of India: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Real-World Speech Recognition in India

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing district-level Word Error Rates (WER) to reveal spatial disparities in ASR model performance across different regions and states in India.

Comparing model Word Error Rates (WER) across 15 different Indian languages and dialects to identify performance gaps between well-represented languages (e.g., Hindi) and underrepresented ones (e.g., Bhojpuri, Maithili).
Comparing average Word Error Rates (WER) between male and female speakers to identify performance disparities.
Evaluating average Word Error Rates (WER) across different speaker age groups, specifically comparing younger speakers (18-22) against older speakers (46+).
Measuring differences in average Word Error Rates (WER) based on the income levels of the speakers.
